successCriteria.description: src/modules/notification/notification.service.ts exports a NotificationService class that implements INotificationService with exactly the three operations declared in src/modules/notification/notification.model.ts: create(input: CreateNotificationInput): Promise<Notification>, markRead(id: string): Promise<Notification>, findByRecipient(recipientId: string, client?: PoolClient): Promise<Notification[]>.

NotificationService.create generates id (randomUUID) and createdAt, sets status to 'PENDING' and readAt to null, and delegates persistence to the injected repository WITHOUT opening a transaction (mirroring BalanceService.create).

NotificationService.markRead wraps the repository markRead call in the injected IUnitOfWork.withTransaction, and an InvalidNotificationTransitionError raised by the repository propagates to the caller unchanged.
NotificationService.findByRecipient accepts an optional PoolClient as its LAST parameter and passes it through to the repository, falling back to the shared pool when omitted.

src/modules/notification/notification.routes.ts exports an async notificationRoutes(fastify: FastifyInstance) function that instantiates NotificationService with PgNotificationRepository and UnitOfWork and registers endpoints wired to the service.

Notification routes validate inputs with Zod safeParse, returning 400 with { error, code: 'VALIDATION_ERROR' } on failure, and map InvalidNotificationTransitionError to a 400/404 typed error rather than a 500.
src/modules/notification/index.ts re-exports NotificationService and notificationRoutes in addition to the existing model and repository symbols.

constraints: NotificationService constructor takes the repository (PgNotificationRepository) and IUnitOfWork as injected dependencies; it never imports the pool, a pg client, or any module-level DB helper directly.
The service owns the unit of work: markRead uses uow.withTransaction(fn); create and findByRecipient do not open a transaction. No withTransaction call may appear on the repository.
Do not reference the leave module or any leave-module symbol.
Do not modify src/modules/balance/balance.service.ts, balance.routes.ts, or balance/index.ts.
Do not create or require any test files; unit/integration tests are out of scope for this sub-phase.

NotificationService must implement the exact INotificationService interface from notification.model.ts — no additional public methods, no changed signatures, no optional-client parameter added to markRead.
outOfScope: Any leave-module orchestration that creates notifications (Phase 4).

ambiguities.description: Exact notification endpoint paths and RBAC roles are not specified in any committed artifact (ARCHITECTURE.md marks notification part 2/2 deferred). The route surface and role requirements must be decided.
options: Mirror balance routes: reads HR_ADMIN|MANAGER, writes HR_ADMIN-only
Employee-own-resource scoping: EMPLOYEE can read/markRead own notifications

entityInvariants.invariant: A Notification's status may only transition PENDING|SENT -> READ; readAt is set only on that transition and is null otherwise; any other transition raises InvalidNotificationTransitionError (enforced by the repository, propagated by the service).
A newly created Notification has status 'PENDING', readAt null, and a service-generated id and createdAt; type must be a valid NotificationType value.

interfaceConstraints.authRule: Route-level: HR_ADMIN only (mirrors balance write endpoints).
interfaceConstraints.errorSemantics: Invalid input -> 400 VALIDATION_ERROR; unexpected error -> 500 INTERNAL_ERROR.

interfaceConstraints.authRule: Route-level: HR_ADMIN or MANAGER (mirrors balance read endpoints).
interfaceConstraints.errorSemantics: InvalidNotificationTransitionError -> 400 VALIDATION_ERROR (or 404 NOT_FOUND); unexpected error -> 500 INTERNAL_ERROR.

interfaceConstraints.authRule: Route-level: HR_ADMIN or MANAGER (mirrors balance read endpoints).
interfaceConstraints.errorSemantics: Unexpected error -> 500 INTERNAL_ERROR; empty result is a valid 200 with [].

consistencyRequirements.requirement: NotificationService must implement the exact INotificationService interface (create/markRead/findByRecipient signatures) and reuse Notification, CreateNotificationInput, NotificationStatus, InvalidNotificationTransitionError.
NotificationService must delegate persistence to PgNotificationRepository (create/findByRecipient/markRead) and rely on its status-transition guard and pool fallback; no inline SQL in the service.

NotificationService must mirror BalanceService's structure: constructor(repository, uow), create without transaction, markRead via uow.withTransaction, findByRecipient passing the optional client through.

notification.routes.ts must follow balance.routes.ts's structure: instantiate service with PgNotificationRepository + UnitOfWork, Zod safeParse -> 400 VALIDATION_ERROR, requireRole preHandler, { error, code } responses, 500 INTERNAL_ERROR catch-all.
Use NotificationType (and UserRole for RBAC) from the shared types barrel; do not redefine them.
Use IUnitOfWork/UnitOfWork and the shared pool for DB access; the service takes IUnitOfWork injected and never imports the pool.
Use requireRole for RBAC enforcement on notification endpoints.

integrationPoints.why: Source of the INotificationService contract, entity, and error type the service must implement.
PgNotificationRepository provides the persistence the service delegates to.
UnitOfWork supplies the transaction boundary for markRead.
NotificationType and UserRole enums used by the service and routes.
